page.overview:
Who is Dragon Suppressing Great Immortal?

The was the mother of the Silver Horned King and Golden Horned King.

The Dragon Suppressing Great Immortal was an old woman with tussled, snow-white hair and a wrinkled face. She wore a silk scarf around her head and golden hoop earrings. Her true form was that of a nine-tailed fox.
